name: Complex.integerComplement.ne_zero
script:
intro h
refine h (x := 0) ?_ rfl
first
  | simp [Complex.integerComplement]
  | norm_num [Complex.integerComplement]
  | (simp only [Complex.integerComplement, Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_compl_iff,
        Set.mem_range, not_exists]
     decide)
  | trivial

name: ArithmeticFunction.isMultiplicative_zeta
script:
intro h
first
  | exact absurd h.map_one (by simp [ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply])
  | exact absurd h.map_one (by decide)
  | exact absurd (h.map_mul_of_coprime (Nat.coprime_one_right 0))
      (by simp [ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply])
  | exact absurd (h.map_mul_of_coprime (Nat.coprime_one_left 0))
      (by simp [ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply])
  | (obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := h
     simp_all [ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply])
  | simp_all [ArithmeticFunction.IsMultiplicative, ArithmeticFunction.zeta_apply]

name: Matrix.gram_apply
script:
intro h
have h2 := @h (ULift.{u_1} Bool) (ULift.{u_2} Bool) (ULift.{u_4} Bool)
    ⟨fun x _ => ULift.up x.down⟩ (fun i => ULift.up i.down)
    (ULift.up true) (ULift.up false)
have h3 : (false : Bool) = true := congrArg ULift.down h2
exact Bool.noConfusion h3

name: Real.Angle.toReal_coe_eq_self_add_two_pi_iff
script:
intro h
have hpi := Real.pi_pos
have key := (@h (-2 * Real.pi)).2 (Set.mem_Ioc.2 ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩)
have h2 : (-2 * Real.pi : ℝ) = -2 * Real.pi + 2 * Real.pi := by simpa using key
linarith

name: Complex.comap_exp_nhds_zero
script:
intro h
rw [Filter.ext_iff] at h
have h1 := (h {z : ℂ | z.re < 0}).2 ⟨Set.Iio 0, Filter.Iio_mem_atBot 0, fun z hz => hz⟩
rw [Filter.mem_comap] at h1
obtain ⟨t, ht, hts⟩ := h1
obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.mem_nhds_iff.1 ht
have key : ∀ x : ℝ, Real.exp x < ε → x < 0 := by
  intro x hx
  have hmem : ((x : ℝ) : ℂ) ∈ {z : ℂ | z.re < 0} := by
    refine hts (hball ?_)
    simpa [Metric.mem_ball, dist_eq_norm, Complex.norm_exp] using hx
  simpa using hmem
have hlt : Real.exp (Real.log ε) < ε := by
  rw [Real.exp_log hε]
  exact lt_irrefl ε |>.elim
exact absurd (key (Real.log ε) hlt) (by simp)

name: Monotone.comp_le_comp_left
script:
intro H
have h : (id ∘ fun _ : Bool => false) ≤ (id ∘ fun _ : Bool => true) :=
  H (α := Bool) (β := Bool) (γ := Bool) (f := id) (g := fun _ => false)
    (h := fun _ => true) monotone_id (by decide)
have h' := h true
revert h'
decide
